statement.en: Plot the cylindrical-coordinate points and find their rectangular coordinates: (a) \(\left( 5, \  \frac{\pi}{2}, \  2\right)\), (b) \(\left( 6, \  - \frac{\pi}{4}, \  -3\right)\)

hint.ko: \(x=r\cos\theta,y=r\sin\theta\)이며 z는 그대로이다. 각도의 사분면을 확인한다.

en: (a) \[(x,y,z)=(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta,z)=\left( 0, \  5, \  2\right)\]

statement.ko: 그림의 \(0\le z\le2-x^2-y^2,x^2+y^2\le1\)에서 \(f=x^2+y^2\). (a) 원주좌표 적분을 세우고 (b) 계산하라.
statement.en: For \(0\le z\le2-x^2-y^2,x^2+y^2\le1\) and \(f=x^2+y^2\), (a) set up a cylindrical integral and (b) evaluate it.

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

en: Here \(f=r^2\), the cylinder is \(r=1\), and \(dV=r\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\). \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{0}^{2 - r^{2}}\left(r^{3}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{0}^{2 - r^{2}}\left(r^{3}\right)\,dz=r^{3} \left(2 - r^{2}\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{1}\left(r^{3} \left(2 - r^{2}\right)\right)\,dr=\frac{1}{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{2 \pi}{3}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.ko: 그림의 원뿔 \(z=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\)와 포물면 \(z=6-x^2-y^2\) 사이에서 \(f=xy\). (a) 원주좌표 적분을 세우고 (b) 계산하라.
statement.en: For \(f=xy\) between the cone \(z=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\) and paraboloid \(z=6-x^2-y^2\), (a) set up a cylindrical integral and (b) evaluate it.

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

en: The intersection \(r=6-r^2\) gives \(r=2\). Also \(xy=r^2\cos\theta\sin\theta\). \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{2}\int_{r}^{6 - r^{2}}\left(r^{3} \sin{\left(\theta \right)} \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]

Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{r}^{6 - r^{2}}\left(r^{3} \sin{\left(\theta \right)} \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz=\frac{r^{3} \left(- r^{2} - r + 6\right) \sin{\left(2 \theta \right)}}{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{2}\left(\frac{r^{3} \left(- r^{2} - r + 6\right) \sin{\left(2 \theta \right)}}{2}\right)\,dr=\frac{52 \sin{\left(2 \theta \right)}}{15}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{52 \sin{\left(2 \theta \right)}}{15}\right)\,d\theta=0\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.en: Sketch the solid and evaluate \(\int_{\pi/2}^{3\pi/2}\int_0^3\int_{r^2}^9r\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 포물면 \(z=r^2\) 위, 평면 \(z=9\) 아래의 입체 중 \(x\le0\)인 절반이다. \[I=\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}\int_{0}^{3}\int_{r^{2}}^{9}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
en: This is the \(x\le0\) half of the solid above \(z=r^2\) and below \(z=9\). \[I=\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}\int_{0}^{3}\int_{r^{2}}^{9}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{r^{2}}^{9}\left(r\right)\,dz=r \left(9 - r^{2}\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{3}\left(r \left(9 - r^{2}\right)\right)\,dr=\frac{81}{4}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}\left(\frac{81}{4}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{81 \pi}{4}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.en: Sketch the solid and evaluate \(\int_0^2\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^r r\,dz\,d\theta\,dr\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 반지름2의 원기둥 안에서 \(z=0\) 위, 원뿔 \(z=r\) 아래인 입체이다. \[I=\int_{0}^{2}\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{r}\left(r\right)\,dz\,d\theta\,dr\]
en: The solid is inside the radius2 cylinder, above \(z=0\), and below the cone \(z=r\). \[I=\int_{0}^{2}\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{r}\left(r\right)\,dz\,d\theta\,dr\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{0}^{r}\left(r\right)\,dz=r^{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(r^{2}\right)\,d\theta=2 \pi r^{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{2}\left(2 \pi r^{2}\right)\,dr=\frac{16 \pi}{3}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.

statement.en: Use cylindrical coordinates to evaluate \(\iiint\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\,dV\) over \(x^2+y^2\le16,-5\le z\le4\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 반지름4, 높이9의 원기둥이다. 피적분함수는 r이고 야코비안을 포함하면 r²이다. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{4}\int_{-5}^{4}\left(r^{2}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
en: The cylinder has radius4 and height9. The integrand is r, becoming r² after including the Jacobian. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{4}\int_{-5}^{4}\left(r^{2}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{-5}^{4}\left(r^{2}\right)\,dz=9 r^{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{4}\left(9 r^{2}\right)\,dr=192\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(192\right)\,d\theta=384 \pi\]

statement.en: Evaluate \(\iiint z\,dV\) between \(z=x^2+y^2\) and \(z=4\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

en: The intersection has r²=4, giving radius range0 to2. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{2}\int_{r^{2}}^{4}\left(r z\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{r^{2}}^{4}\left(r z\right)\,dz=\frac{r \left(16 - r^{4}\right)}{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{2}\left(\frac{r \left(16 - r^{4}\right)}{2}\right)\,dr=\frac{32}{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{32}{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{64 \pi}{3}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.en: Evaluate \(\iiint(x+y+z)dV\) in the first octant below \(z=4-x^2-y^2\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 제1팔분공간이므로 각도는0에서π/2이며 높이는0에서4-r²이다. \[I=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\int_{0}^{2}\int_{0}^{4 - r^{2}}\left(r \left(r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + r \cos{\left(\theta \right)} + z\right)\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]

\(z\) 적분을 수행한다. \[\int_{0}^{4 - r^{2}}\left(r \left(r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + r \cos{\left(\theta \right)} + z\right)\right)\,dz=\frac{r \left(r^{2} - 4\right) \left(r^{2} - 2 \sqrt{2} r \sin{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)} - 4\right)}{2}\]
en: The first octant gives angles0 toπ/2 and height0 to4-r². \[I=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\int_{0}^{2}\int_{0}^{4 - r^{2}}\left(r \left(r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + r \cos{\left(\theta \right)} + z\right)\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]

Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{0}^{4 - r^{2}}\left(r \left(r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + r \cos{\left(\theta \right)} + z\right)\right)\,dz=\frac{r \left(r^{2} - 4\right) \left(r^{2} - 2 \sqrt{2} r \sin{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)} - 4\right)}{2}\]

Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{2}\left(\frac{r \left(r^{2} - 4\right) \left(r^{2} - 2 \sqrt{2} r \sin{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)} - 4\right)}{2}\right)\,dr=\frac{64 \sqrt{2} \sin{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}}{15} + \frac{16}{3}\]

Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\frac{64 \sqrt{2} \sin{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}}{15} + \frac{16}{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{8 \pi}{3} + \frac{128}{15}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.en: Evaluate \(\iiint(x-y)dV\) over \(1\le x^2+y^2\le16,0\le z\le y+4\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 원환에서 높이는4+r sinθ로 음수가 아니다. 각도 적분을 먼저 하면 홀수 삼각항이 소거된다. \[I=\int_{1}^{4}\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + 4}\left(r^{2} \left(- \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\right)\,dz\,d\theta\,dr\]
en: The annular region has nonnegative height4+r sinθ. Integrating angle before radius cancels odd trigonometric terms. \[I=\int_{1}^{4}\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + 4}\left(r^{2} \left(- \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\right)\,dz\,d\theta\,dr\]

Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{0}^{r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + 4}\left(r^{2} \left(- \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\right)\,dz=\sqrt{2} r^{2} \left(r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + 4\right) \cos{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\sqrt{2} r^{2} \left(r \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + 4\right) \cos{\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\right)\,d\theta=- \pi r^{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{1}^{4}\left(- \pi r^{3}\right)\,dr=- \frac{255 \pi}{4}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.ko: \(x^2+y^2\le1\), z=0 위와 원뿔 \(z^2=4x^2+4y^2\)의 위쪽 가지 아래에서 \(\iiint x^2dV\)를 구하라.
statement.en: Evaluate \(\iiint x^2dV\) inside \(x^2+y^2\le1\), above z=0 and below the upper branch of \(z^2=4x^2+4y^2\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: z≥0 조건이 원뿔 가지 z=2r을 선택한다. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{0}^{2 r}\left(r^{3} \cos^{2}{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
en: The condition z≥0 selects the cone branch z=2r. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{0}^{2 r}\left(r^{3} \cos^{2}{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{0}^{2 r}\left(r^{3} \cos^{2}{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz=2 r^{4} \cos^{2}{\left(\theta \right)}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{1}\left(2 r^{4} \cos^{2}{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dr=\frac{2 \cos^{2}{\left(\theta \right)}}{5}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{2 \cos^{2}{\left(\theta \right)}}{5}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{2 \pi}{5}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.ko: 원기둥 \(x^2+y^2\le1\)과 구 \(x^2+y^2+z^2\le4\)의 공통 부분 부피를 구하라.
statement.en: Find the volume common to \(x^2+y^2\le1\) and \(x^2+y^2+z^2\le4\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 각 r에서 구의 아래·위 반구 사이 높이2√(4-r²)를 사용한다. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{- \sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}^{\sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
\(z\) 적분을 수행한다. \[\int_{- \sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}^{\sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz=2 r \sqrt{4 - r^{2}}\]
en: At each r the height between the lower and upper hemispheres is2√(4-r²). \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{- \sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}^{\sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{- \sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}^{\sqrt{4 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz=2 r \sqrt{4 - r^{2}}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{1}\left(2 r \sqrt{4 - r^{2}}\right)\,dr=\frac{16}{3} - 2 \sqrt{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{16}{3} - 2 \sqrt{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{4 \pi \left(8 - 3 \sqrt{3}\right)}{3}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.ko: 원뿔 \(z=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\) 위와 구 \(x^2+y^2+z^2=2\) 아래 사이 입체의 부피를 구하라.
statement.en: Find the volume above \(z=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\) and inside the sphere \(x^2+y^2+z^2=2\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

en: At the intersection, r²+r²=2, so r=1. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{r}^{\sqrt{2 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{r}^{\sqrt{2 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz=r \left(- r + \sqrt{2 - r^{2}}\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{1}\left(r \left(- r + \sqrt{2 - r^{2}}\right)\right)\,dr=- \frac{2}{3} + \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(- \frac{2}{3} + \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{4 \pi \left(-1 + \sqrt{2}\right)}{3}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.ko: 포물면 \(z=x^2+y^2\) 위와 구 \(x^2+y^2+z^2=2\) 아래 사이 부피를 구하라.
statement.en: Find the volume above \(z=x^2+y^2\) and inside \(x^2+y^2+z^2=2\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 교선에서 r⁴+r²=2이므로 r²=1이다. 음의 대수적 근은 반지름제곱이 될 수 없다. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{r^{2}}^{\sqrt{2 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
en: The intersection satisfies r⁴+r²=2, giving r²=1; the negative algebraic root is inadmissible. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{1}\int_{r^{2}}^{\sqrt{2 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{r^{2}}^{\sqrt{2 - r^{2}}}\left(r\right)\,dz=r \left(- r^{2} + \sqrt{2 - r^{2}}\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{1}\left(r \left(- r^{2} + \sqrt{2 - r^{2}}\right)\right)\,dr=- \frac{7}{12} + \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(- \frac{7}{12} + \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{\pi \left(-7 + 8 \sqrt{2}\right)}{6}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.en: Find (a) the volume and (b) the centroid between \(z=24-x^2-y^2\) and \(z=2\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 교선은 r²+2r-24=0의 양의 근 r=4이다. 회전대칭으로 x̄=ȳ=0이다. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{4}\int_{2 r}^{24 - r^{2}}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
\(z\) 적분을 수행한다. \[\int_{2 r}^{24 - r^{2}}\left(r\right)\,dz=r \left(- r^{2} - 2 r + 24\right)\]
\(z\) 적분을 수행한다. \[\int_{2 r}^{24 - r^{2}}\left(r z\right)\,dz=\frac{r \left(r^{4} - 52 r^{2} + 576\right)}{2}\]
en: The positive intersection root of r²+2r-24=0 is r=4. Rotational symmetry gives x̄=ȳ=0. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{4}\int_{2 r}^{24 - r^{2}}\left(r\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{2 r}^{24 - r^{2}}\left(r\right)\,dz=r \left(- r^{2} - 2 r + 24\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{4}\left(r \left(- r^{2} - 2 r + 24\right)\right)\,dr=\frac{256}{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{256}{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{512 \pi}{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{2 r}^{24 - r^{2}}\left(r z\right)\,dz=\frac{r \left(r^{4} - 52 r^{2} + 576\right)}{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{4}\left(\frac{r \left(r^{4} - 52 r^{2} + 576\right)}{2}\right)\,dr=\frac{2944}{3}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{2944}{3}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{5888 \pi}{3}\]
\[\bar z=\frac{N_z}{V}=\frac{23}{2}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

topic.en: Intersection of a sphere and an offset cylinder

statement.ko: (a) 원점 중심 반지름a의 구에서 원기둥 \(r=a\cos\theta\) 내부가 잘라내는 부피를 구하라. (b) 두 곡면을 함께 그려라.
statement.en: (a) Find the volume inside both the radius-a sphere centered at the origin and the cylinder \(r=a\cos\theta\). (b) Plot the sphere and cylinder together.

hint.ko: 원기둥은 \((x-a/2)^2+y^2=(a/2)^2\)이며 각도는 -π/2에서π/2이다.
hint.en: The cylinder is \((x-a/2)^2+y^2=(a/2)^2\), with angles from-π/2 toπ/2.

ko: 위·아래 구면 사이에 놓인 높이를 적분한다. \[V=\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}\int_0^{a\cos\theta}2r\sqrt{a^2-r^2}\,dr\,d\theta\]
r 적분은 \(\frac{2a^3}{3}(1-|\sin\theta|^3)\)이다. θ의 대칭으로0부터π/2 적분의2배를 쓴다.
(b) 그림은 a=1로 정규화했다. 모든 좌표를 a배 하면 일반 경우를 얻는다.
en: Integrate the height between the two hemispheres. \[V=\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}\int_0^{a\cos\theta}2r\sqrt{a^2-r^2}\,dr\,d\theta\]
The r-integral is \(\frac{2a^3}{3}(1-|\sin\theta|^3)\). Use twice the angular integral from0 toπ/2.
Since \(\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^3\theta\,d\theta=2/3\), \[V=\frac{4a^3}{3}\left(\frac\pi2-\frac23\right)\]
(b) The diagram is normalized to a=1; multiply all coordinates by a for the general case.

check.ko: 부피가 a³에 비례하며 반구 부피보다 작다. 절댓값을 빠뜨리지 않도록 각도 구간을 대칭으로 나누었다.
check.en: The volume scales as a³ and is smaller than a hemisphere. The angular symmetry split preserves the absolute value.

alt.en: Solid generated directly from the boundary equations

statement.ko: \(z=4x^2+4y^2\)와 \(z=a\), a>0 사이 입체의 일정 밀도가 K일 때 질량과 질량중심을 구하라.
statement.en: Find mass and center of mass between \(z=4x^2+4y^2\) and \(z=a\), a>0, for constant density K.

hint.ko: 부피를 구해 K를 곱하고, z모멘트를 질량으로 나눈다.
hint.en: Multiply volume by K for mass and divide the z-moment by mass.

ko: 범위는 \(0\le r\le\sqrt a/2,4r^2\le z\le a\)이다. 회전대칭으로 x̄=ȳ=0.
질량은 \(K V\), 높이 모멘트는 \[N_z=K\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{\sqrt a/2}\int_{4r^2}^a zr\,dz\,dr\,d\theta=K\frac{\pi a^{3}}{12}\]
en: The bounds are \(0\le r\le\sqrt a/2,4r^2\le z\le a\). Rotational symmetry gives x̄=ȳ=0.
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{4 r^{2}}^{a}\left(r\right)\,dz=r \left(a - 4 r^{2}\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{a}}{2}}\left(r \left(a - 4 r^{2}\right)\right)\,dr=\frac{a^{2}}{16}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{a^{2}}{16}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{\pi a^{2}}{8}\]
The mass is \(KV\), and the height moment is \[N_z=K\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{\sqrt a/2}\int_{4r^2}^a zr\,dz\,dr\,d\theta=K\frac{\pi a^{3}}{12}\]

check.ko: 높이 z의 원판 단면적은 πz/4이므로 1변수 질량·모멘트 적분으로도 같은 값을 얻는다.
check.en: The horizontal disk area is πz/4, yielding the same mass and moment by one-variable integration.

statement.ko: 반지름a의 원점 중심 구에서 밀도가 z축까지 거리에 비례한다. 비례상수 k>0일 때 질량을 구하라.
statement.en: Find the mass of a radius-a ball when density is k times distance from the z-axis.

hint.ko: 밀도 kr과 원주좌표 야코비안 r을 모두 곱한다.
hint.en: Include both the density kr and the cylindrical Jacobian r.

ko: 각 r의 높이는 두 반구 사이 거리이므로 \[M=4\pi k\int_0^a r^2\sqrt{a^2-r^2}dr\]
en: The height at each radius is the distance between the two hemispheres: \[M=4\pi k\int_0^a r^2\sqrt{a^2-r^2}dr\]
Substitute \(r=a\sin u\), \(0\le u\le\pi/2\): \[M=4\pi k a^4\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2u\cos^2u\,du\]
The identity \(\sin^2u\cos^2u=(1-\cos4u)/8\) gives integral \(\pi/16\).

check.ko: 구면좌표에서 밀도 \(k\rho\sin\phi\)를 적분해도 같은 값이다.
check.en: Spherical integration of density \(k\rho\sin\phi\) gives the same result.

statement.en: Convert and evaluate \(\int_{-2}^2\int_{-\sqrt{4-y^2}}^{\sqrt{4-y^2}}\int_{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}^2xz\,dz\,dx\,dy\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

ko: 밑면은 반지름2의 원판이며 r≤z≤2이다. xz와 야코비안의 곱은 r²z cosθ이다. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{2}\int_{r}^{2}\left(r^{2} z \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
en: The base is the radius2 disk and r≤z≤2. The transformed integrand including the Jacobian is r²z cosθ. \[I=\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\int_{0}^{2}\int_{r}^{2}\left(r^{2} z \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{r}^{2}\left(r^{2} z \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\right)\,dz=\frac{r^{2} \left(4 - r^{2}\right) \cos{\left(\theta \right)}}{2}\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{2}\left(\frac{r^{2} \left(4 - r^{2}\right) \cos{\left(\theta \right)}}{2}\right)\,dr=\frac{32 \cos{\left(\theta \right)}}{15}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(\frac{32 \cos{\left(\theta \right)}}{15}\right)\,d\theta=0\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

statement.en: Convert and evaluate \(\int_{-3}^3\int_0^{\sqrt{9-x^2}}\int_0^{9-x^2-y^2}\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\,dz\,dy\,dx\).

hint.ko: 경계 곡면의 교선을 먼저 구하고 좌표변환의 야코비안을 곱한다.
hint.en: Find boundary intersections first, then include the coordinate Jacobian.

en: The base is the half-disk y≥0, so the angle runs from0 toπ. \[I=\int_{0}^{\pi}\int_{0}^{3}\int_{0}^{9 - r^{2}}\left(r^{2}\right)\,dz\,dr\,d\theta\]
Integrate with respect to \(z\). \[\int_{0}^{9 - r^{2}}\left(r^{2}\right)\,dz=r^{2} \left(9 - r^{2}\right)\]
Integrate with respect to \(r\). \[\int_{0}^{3}\left(r^{2} \left(9 - r^{2}\right)\right)\,dr=\frac{162}{5}\]
Integrate with respect to \(\theta\). \[\int_{0}^{\pi}\left(\frac{162}{5}\right)\,d\theta=\frac{162 \pi}{5}\]

check.ko: 경계 교선과 적분구간을 원래 좌표식에 대입해 대조하고 기호 적분을 수행했다.
check.en: The boundary intersections and integration limits were checked in the original equations and the integral was evaluated symbolically.

topic.en: Work required to form a mountain

statement.ko: 해수면에서 원뿔 모양 산을 만든다. (a) 점 P의 무게밀도 g(P), 높이 h(P)를 써서 일을 적분으로 표현하라. (b) 반지름62000 ft, 높이12400 ft, 일정 무게밀도200 lb/ft³인 산의 일을 구하라.
statement.en: A conical mountain is raised from sea level. (a) Express the work using weight density g(P) and height h(P). (b) Calculate it for radius 62000 ft, height 12400 ft, and constant weight density 200 lb/ft³.

hint.ko: 작은 부피의 무게에 들어 올리는 높이를 곱한다.
hint.en: Multiply the weight of a small volume by its lifting height.

ko: (a) \(dW=g(P)h(P)dV\)이므로 \(W=\iiint_E g(P)h(P)dV\). 원뿔 밑면을 z=0에 두면 h(P)=z이다.
반지름R, 높이H에 대해 높이z 단면의 반지름은 R(1-z/H)이다. \[W=\int_0^H\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{R(1-z/H)}g(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta,z)\,zr\,dr\,d\theta\,dz\]
(b) 일정 무게밀도 w이면 \[W=w\pi R^2\int_0^H z(1-z/H)^2dz=\frac{w\pi R^2H^2}{12}\]
en: (a) \(dW=g(P)h(P)dV\), so \(W=\iiint_E g(P)h(P)dV\). With the base in z=0, h(P)=z.
The cross-section radius at height z is R(1-z/H). \[W=\int_0^H\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{R(1-z/H)}g(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta,z)\,zr\,dr\,d\theta\,dz\]
(b) For constant weight density w, \[W=w\pi R^2\int_0^H z(1-z/H)^2dz=\frac{w\pi R^2H^2}{12}\]
Substitution gives \[W=\frac{29552672000000000000 \pi}{3}\ \mathrm{ft\cdot lb}\approx 3.09474857497e+19\ \mathrm{ft\cdot lb}\]

check.ko: 균질 원뿔의 무게 wπR²H/3에 도심 높이H/4를 곱한 독립 계산과 같다. 무게밀도이므로 중력가속도를 다시 곱하지 않는다.
check.en: Independently, multiply cone weight wπR²H/3 by centroid heightH/4. Because this is weight density, do not multiply by gravitational acceleration again.
